title: vernonia stellulifera
intro: Vernonia stellulifera, commonly known as Star Vernonia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its various health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia stellulifera include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
